$comment: hyg-04. This is a KEEP-LIST WITH REASONS, not a to-delete list. Every row
says why a finding is allowed to stand and names the backlog item id, or
the numbered question under spec.md section 14, that owns it. Nothing is
deleted because it is listed here; things are listed here because they are
kept.
Rows cover only the findings `node scripts/repo-refs.mjs --check` would
otherwise fail on: a file with status `unreferenced` that the never-delete
list does not already keep, and a dependency that is declared-and-unused or
imported-with-no-manifest-entry. The 164 never-delete files (agents/,
skills/, servo_design_system/, prisma/, tests/fixtures/, docs/hygiene/ and
everything .gitignore matches) are kept by data inside the scanner and need
no row.
This file is excluded as a REFERENCING source (NON_REFERENCING_SOURCES in
scripts/repo-refs.mjs). It has to be: .json is a mention extension, so a
baseline counted as a source would make every path it lists read as
referenced, the findings would disappear, and the gate would pass because
it had stopped looking.
A row may only be removed in the same commit that removes the thing it
describes or adds a reference to it. tests/repo-refs-baseline.test.ts
asserts every file row still names something in the tree.
The package rows are keyed "packages", not "dependencies":
scripts/landing-tier.mjs tracks package.json dependency blocks by header
line across the whole staged diff, so a "dependencies" key here would
make every commit touching this file read as a runtime dependency change
and land Tier C. Do not rename it back.
